en.text: I will extol you, LORD, for you have raised me up, and have not made my foes to rejoice over me.
LORD my God, I cried to you, and you have healed me.
LORD, you have brought up my soul from Sheol. have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.

footnotes.text: 30:3 Sheol is the place of the dead.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，你曾把我的灵魂从阴间救上来，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，你曾把我的靈魂從陰間救上來，

en.text: Sing praise to the LORD, you saints of his. Give thanks to his holy name.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华的圣民哪，你们要歌颂他， 。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華的聖民哪，你們要歌頌他， 。

en.text: For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.

zhSimplified.text: 因为，他的怒气不过是转眼之间；

zhTraditional.text: 因為，他的怒氣不過是轉眼之間；

en.text: As for me, I said in my prosperity, I shall never be moved.”

zhSimplified.text: 至于我，我凡事平顺，便说：

zhTraditional.text: 至於我，我凡事平順，便說：

en.text: You, LORD, when you favored me, made my mountain stand strong; but when you hid your face, I was troubled.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，你曾施恩，叫我的山稳固；

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，你曾施恩，叫我的山穩固；

en.text: I cried to you, LORD. I made supplication to the Lord:
“What profit is there in my destruction, if I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise you? Shall it declare your truth?

zhSimplified.text: 我被害流血，下到坑中，有什么益处呢？

zhTraditional.text: 我被害流血，下到坑中，有甚麼益處呢？

en.text: Hear, LORD, and have mercy on me. LORD, be my helper.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，求你应允我，怜恤我！

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，求你應允我，憐恤我！

en.text: You have turned my mourning into dancing for me. You have removed my sackcloth, and clothed me with gladness,

zhSimplified.text: 你已将我的哀哭变为跳舞，

zhTraditional.text: 你已將我的哀哭變為跳舞，

en.text: to the end that my heart may sing praise to you, and not be silent. LORD my God, I will give thanks to you forever!

zhSimplified.text: 好叫我的灵歌颂你，并不住声。

zhTraditional.text: 好叫我的靈歌頌你，並不住聲。
